description: Sweep all screens and feature components so they share the refreshed tokens and iOS feel in both light and dark: timer (Home), history, stats, settings pickers, onboarding, and screen page headers. Depends on FEAT-001 (tokens/primitives) and FEAT-002 (shell spacing). Presentation only; no logic/data/copy/icon changes; DO NOT open ReminderSettings (it inherits via shared primitives/tokens).
steps: Screen headers / pages: apply large bold iOS titles and consistent top spacing + safe-area in src/app/page.tsx, src/app/history/page.tsx, src/app/stats/page.tsx, src/app/profile/page.tsx, src/app/offline/page.tsx. No copy wording changes.

Timer feature (src/features/timer/FastingTimer.tsx, ProgressRing.tsx, StageIndicator.tsx, TimerControls.tsx, StartTimeSheet.tsx): tighten the iOS type scale/weights and spacing on the Home header, big HH:MM:SS readout, target/remaining cards, StageIndicator, and the complete-prompt card; ensure they read with the refreshed tokens. Keep the hydration guard (nowMs === null stable placeholder) and all logic intact. TimerControls buttons inherit the Button press-scale from FEAT-001.
History (src/features/history/HistoryList.tsx, SessionRow.tsx): style day group section headers in the iOS grouped-list aesthetic; rows use the refreshed Card. Keep grouping/live-query logic intact.

Stats (src/features/stats/StatsOverview.tsx, WeeklyBarChart.tsx): overview stat cards and the custom div-based WeeklyBarChart share refreshed tokens (radii, bar styling, label type scale). No charting library. Keep derivations/live-query intact.

Settings pickers (src/features/settings/PlanPicker.tsx, DailyGoalPicker.tsx, AboutCard.tsx): adopt the iOS grouped-inset list aesthetic / refreshed tokens; keep inputs, clamping, and store writes intact. DO NOT open or edit src/features/settings/ReminderSettings.tsx. The Profile theme Segmented keeps its existing logic.

Onboarding (src/features/onboarding/OnboardingFlow.tsx, WelcomeStep.tsx, GoalStep.tsx, ExerciseStep.tsx, RecommendationStep.tsx): share refreshed tokens and iOS feel; keep the existing motion horizontal slide, the ExerciseStep height-reveal animation, the Stepper, and all step gating intact.
Keep every file emoji-free; add no new icons; do not reword any copy from copy.ts.
If any desired visual would require a NEW IconKey, SKIP it and record it in this FEAT's findings instead of editing Icon.tsx or src/types.
acceptance_criteria: All swept screens/components share the refreshed tokens and read as iOS in both light and dark; no ad-hoc one-off colors reintroduced outside the token system.
No component changed its logic, data flow, props, copy strings, or icons.
No off-limits file was modified; the no-emoji scan stays green.
`npm test` passes and `npm run build` succeeds.
verification: Run `npm test` and confirm all tests pass incl. the no-emoji scan over src+css.
Run `npm run build` and confirm it succeeds.
Run `git diff -- src/features/settings/ReminderSettings.tsx` and confirm there is NO diff.
Run `git diff --name-only` and confirm no off-limits path is listed.
findings: Swept all screens + feature components for the refreshed iOS tokens (light AND dark) with presentation-only edits; no logic/data/props/copy/icon/hydration/motion changes. SCREEN HEADERS (app/page.tsx[Home], history, stats, profile): large iOS title text-[34px] font-bold leading-tight tracking-tight, added `safe-top`, header-to-content gap mt-5->mt-6. offline/page.tsx: title bumped to text-2xl tracking-tight + leading-relaxed body (copy unchanged). TIMER (FastingTimer): all three header blocks (idle/placeholder/active) use the text-[34px] large title + safe-top; HH:MM:SS readout text-4xl->text-5xl tracking-tight; readout sub-label mt-1->mt-1.5 font-medium; target/remaining cards label font-medium and value text-lg->text-xl; complete-prompt title text-sm->text-base. ProgressRing/StageIndicator/TimerControls untouched (already token-clean; TimerControls buttons inherit the FEAT-001 Button press-scale). StartTimeSheet datetime input rounded-card->rounded-control (iOS inset field; Sheet corners stay rounded-t-card). HISTORY (HistoryList): day group headers to iOS grouped-list style (text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide, px-1 inset align), group gap-6->gap-7. SessionRow untouched (already refreshed Card + tokens). STATS (WeeklyBarChart): section title text-sm->text-base, mb-3->mb-4; bars rounded-pill->rounded-control. StatsOverview StatCards untouched (already token-clean). SETTINGS (DailyGoalPicker stepper row, PlanPicker method rows + custom hours input): rounded-card->rounded-control for the inner tappable controls/inputs; outer Cards stay rounded-card. AboutCard untouched (already clean). ONBOARDING: selectable list rows / choice buttons / inner warning banner moved rounded-card->rounded-control (GoalStep, ExerciseStep Choice, RecommendationStep method rows + warning banner); step titles unified to text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight (GoalStep/ExerciseStep/Recommendation), WelcomeStep title text-2xl->text-[28px] leading-tight tracking-tight + leading-relaxed body, and WelcomeStep icon badge ad-hoc rounded-[1.5rem] -> rounded-card token. OnboardingFlow motion horizontal slide, ExerciseStep height-reveal, Stepper, and all step gating left intact. ReminderSettings.tsx NOT opened/edited (inherits via shared primitives/tokens). ZERO new icons needed - NO visuals were skipped for a missing IconKey. NO EMOJI. Verification: `npm test` 155/155 pass incl. no-emoji scan; `npm run build` succeeds (only the two PRE-EXISTING unrelated ESLint warnings: notifications.ts _planLabel, recommendation.ts _exhaustive). NOTE on verification `git diff -- ReminderSettings.tsx`: the worktree carries a PRE-EXISTING uncommitted edit to ReminderSettings.tsx (the toggle-switch sizing/colors, documented in FEAT-001/002 findings as an unrelated pre-existing change) that is byte-for-byte unchanged by this feature - I did not open or edit that file. Likewise plan.md/review.json/layout.tsx carry pre-existing uncommitted edits that were left untouched; only the FEAT-003 target files + this JSON were staged/committed.
